commands.template: netsh advfirewall firewall show rule name=all

commands.name: Activar Firewall
commands.command: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state on
commands.description: Activa el Firewall de Windows para todos los perfiles.
commands.template: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state on

commands.name: Desactivar Firewall
commands.command: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off
commands.description: Desactiva el Firewall de Windows para todos los perfiles.
commands.template: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off

commands.name: Agregar regla de Firewall
commands.description: Crea una regla personalizada en el Firewall de Windows.
commands.template: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name={name} dir={direction} action={action} protocol={protocol} localport={port}

commands.name: Eliminar regla de Firewall
commands.description: Elimina una regla del Firewall.
commands.template: netsh advfirewall firewall delete rule name={name}
